concern_summary: This concern focuses on the review process for transactions that may involve duplicates, assessing whether certain conditions necessitate a review based on transaction violations, and determining if duplicated transactions require further action.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to identifying, tracking, and managing duplicate transactions in the system. It includes checking for transaction violations related to duplicates, managing the data related to duplicate transactions, and providing options for handling them.
This concern is dedicated to the navigation mechanics within the chat environment, including handling links specific to chat screens and report access based on the users' actions.
This concern centers on monitoring and managing application state, responding to transitions between active and background states, and optimizing user interface elements based on state changes.
This concern defines functionalities to identify and navigate within one-on-one chat interactions, ensuring proper detection and access to individual chat reports.
This concern focuses on application updates, including managing silent update events, invoking update callbacks, and handling user interactions related to updating the application.
This concern highlights functionalities specifically aimed at handling split chat reports and policy expense chats, managing participant interactions and the flow of expense-related processes.

This concern encompasses the overall application lifecycle management, including initializing the application, checking its readiness, managing its state, and facilitating user interactions such as sign-in and context management.

This concern encapsulates the functionalities related to detecting and handling tap gestures, which include single and double tap interactions, focusing the camera, and managing input field focus within the user interface.
